PC-GEN-024.question: An insurer incorporated in Canada and licensed to do business in Pennsylvania is classified in Pennsylvania as a(n):

PC-OTH-014.explanation: FAIR plans are residual markets that give owners basic property insurance when the voluntary market will not. In Pennsylvania the plan is run by the insurers' Industry Placement Facility under the Pennsylvania Fair Plan Act and supervised by the commissioner; automobile assigned risk plans serve high-risk drivers.

excluded.PC-AUTO-012: Part B medical payments: Pennsylvania auto policies carry first-party medical benefits under 75 Pa.C.S. 1711 instead; tested by PCPA-PAAUT-003.
excluded.PC-AUTO-018: UM stacking is set by 75 Pa.C.S. 1738 (stacked unless waived in writing); tested by PCPA-PAAUT-005.
excluded.PC-AUTO-030: Personal auto cancellation reasons are tested by the Pennsylvania items under Insurance Company Law Article XX.
excluded.PC-POL-024: Return of unearned premium on commercial cancellation is set by Act 86 of 1986 (10 business days); tested by PCPA-PAPOL-005.
excluded.PC-POL-025: Same as PC-POL-024 for insured-initiated cancellation.
